camera_mapping: shader CTAB cViewProj at c8..c11, register_rows; selected from same-frame HDR draws before first snapshot
limitations: Only three 8-frame samples; no Reset observed
No object motion, disocclusion filling, jitter or HUD integration validation
Nearest sampling at stride 3 limits edge and far-depth precision
conclusion: Camera reprojection mapping strongly supported on these captured static-scene pixels by shader CTAB, cross-shader constant agreement, expected stationary/turn/translation changes and depth/color improvements versus identity; production motion vectors and frame generation are not implemented or validated.

method.sampling: nearest stride=3 offset=1, integer D3D9 pixel center
method.formula: previous_clip = previous_cViewProj @ inverse(current_cViewProj) @ current_clip; perspective divide; previous viewport
method.mask: current and warped previous depth between 0.2 and 1 exclusive; positive W, in-bounds, projected depth 0..1
method.photometric: RGB preview MAE 0..255 on same warped-valid mask for reprojection and identity, unweighted means across five moving pairs
method.depth: Absolute nonlinear device-depth errors at 1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-3; not uniform world-space distances
method.sky: Depth==1 excluded; must handle sky separately
method.producer: Original events unchanged; earlier same-frame same-render-target and viewport draw selected explicitly; original snapshot last draw is not rewritten
method.initial_still_frames: Frames 0,1,2 have unchanged cViewProj in turn/translation runs; moving pairs are 2->3 through 6->7
method.controls: Identity transform plus transpose-storage negative control, evaluated separately; valid masks differ for the transpose control, so its aggregate errors are not directly comparable.
